name: Co-occurrence Pixel Entropy Matrix (GLCM)
description: An uncompromising radiation meter for digital chaos (Gray Level Co-occurrence Matrix). An authentic optical photograph carries a harmonic, predictable microscopic structural topology within its textures (e.g., fabric weaves, skin pores). Malicious digital actors (or generative AI models) chaotically mangle this pixel fabric. This measurement mercilessly exposes whether an image's underlying topology is either violently chaotic (from crude splicing) or morbidly flat and sterile (from AI blindly scrubbing away natural textures).
mechanism: This engine forcefully abducts every single pixel and aggressively interrogates its specific intensity relationship with its immediate neighbors. It then constructs a colossal Co-occurrence Matrix (GLCM) to calculate the overarching informational bandwidth (Entropy) encoded in the image. No matter how stunning an AI’s output is, it computationally fails to hallucinate an authentic natural optical texture distribution. The system sounds an unyielding alarm the moment it traps a 'soulless', statistically dead entropy void within a forged region.
parameters: Core Reactor: Gray-Level Co-occurrence Matrix (GLCM), Operator: Shannon Entropy Equation, Displacement: D=1 across Multi-Angle Vectors
accuracy: Solid (68-83%) - Acts as an absolute tyrant against crude textural cloning, in-painting failures, or AI skin-smoothing operations.
source: Haralick et al. (1973) - Textural Structural Physics Topography
useCase: Stands as an extreme forensic tribunal dedicated to stripping away the mask of synthetic skin, rock, or foliage, proving on the spot that the region is a computational wasteland lacking any true organic complexity.

references.title: Haralick, R.M., Shanmugam, K., & Dinstein, I. (1973). Textural features for image classification. IEEE TSMC.
Haralick, R.M. et al. (1973). Textural Features for Image Classification. IEEE TSMC.
Shannon, C.E. (1948). A Mathematical Theory of Communication. Bell System Technical Journal.

strengths:
• Quantifies textural indiscipline invisibility, completely bypassing the subjective gaze of the human eye.
• Instantly execution-style condemns the hyper-smooth 'plastic skin' phenomenon generated by Diffusion models (which mathematically annihilates natural optical pore entropy).
limitations:
• Susceptible to striking blind (False Positives) against authentic heavily fogged environments, solid-color night skies, or pitch-black darkness, where natural informational entropy is inherently non-existent.
• Violently neutralized if the image is heavily laundered through Facebook/WhatsApp compression, which turns the GLCM texture grid into muddy, disorienting sludge.
